4279-4699-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4699-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4381-4694-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
4381-4694-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1170-2981-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
392-1170-2981-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4153-4186-5256--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3617-4064-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Abuelo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1496-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7154.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3899-4365-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3912-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3293-5412-5721-6664.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5412-5721-6664.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5412-5721-6664.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

182-4899-6907.notablePrerequisites: The combined mana value of cards in library is greater than or equal to your opponents' life totals.
182-4899-6907.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until your library is empty or the number of cards you own in exile is equal to or greater than each opponent's life total.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Cosmogoyf, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Cosmogoyf's power.
Activate Phyrexian Devourer's second ability by exiling the top card of your library, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on Phyrexian Devourer equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 until Phyrexian Devourer's power is greater than each opponent's life total.
Phyrexian Devourer's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Phyrexian Devourer, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Phyrexian Devourer's power.

3490-5231-6829.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Venom triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3000-4452-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1742-2428-3583.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

292-4968-6774.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4968-6774.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2018-3826-4050.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-3826-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Medicine Runner, adding one mana of any color.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Repeat.

3967-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1737-2793-2829.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat each turn.

2724-3036-4006.notablePrerequisites: Wizard Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
2724-3036-4006.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushbringer.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

141-413-1223.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-413-1223.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing that much damage to any target(s).

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2921-5370-5434.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

235-731-5438.description:
Cast Explosive Singularity by paying at most {8}{R}{R}, dealing 10 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

2966-2999-3253-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
2966-2999-3253-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

3961-4613-4868-4929.notablePrerequisites: Tekuthal has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3961-4613-4868-4929.description:
Activate Tekuthal using Myojin of Towering Might's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting five +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite, and three +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Tekuthal by paying {3} and removing three +1/+1 counters from Cryptic Trilobite, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.

2068-2435-5009.notablePrerequisites: Apprentice Necromancer does not have summoning sickness.
2068-2435-5009.description:
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing it.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Ruthless Knave's ability.
Resolve both Ruthless Knave abilities, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Ruthless Knave.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Ruthless Knave from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat

238-3008-4050-4347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six additional nontoken creatures.
238-3008-4050-4347.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six additional nontoken creatures, adding {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Misthollow Griffin by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Misthollow Griffin.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing Misthollow Griffin to become a copy of Gerrard.
Put Misthollow Griffin in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Misthollow Griffin dies as a copy of Gerrard, it triggers, exiling itself and returning all other artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control a seventh additional nontoken creature, you may sacrifice it as well each loop to get infinite colored mana.

397-3129-3868.notablePrerequisites: You control a Treasure token, and at least one creature.
397-3129-3868.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Citizens and another creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Stimulus Package twice by sacrificing the Treasures, creating four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Citizens, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-3499-4629-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
1981-3499-4629-5231.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each player and each creature your opponent control.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

210-220-3809-5195.description:
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve Chain Lightning, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter, and causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, targeting Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Storm-Kiln Artist each trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing 3 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger

1873-3417.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
1873-3417.description:
Deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger
Fiendlash and Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger trigger.
Resolve the Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing damage to any player or planeswalker.
Resolve the Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
1873-3417.notes: Either Ill-Tempered Loner or Howlpack Avenger can be on the battlefield and the combo will function. If Howlpack Avenger is on the battlefield, you can instead have Fiendlash attached to a different indestructible creature, and deal damage to the creature.

43-1923.notablePrerequisites:
You control nonland permanents that can tap for at least {3}{W}.
You control at least 2 additional Merfolk permanents.
43-1923.description:
Cast Summon the School for {3}{W}.
Paradox Egine triggers, untapping your nonlands permanents.
Tap your nonland permanents for at least {3}{W}.
Summon the School resolves, creating two 1/1 Merfolk tokens.
Tap 4 Merfolk you control to return Summon the School to your hand.
Repeat for infinite mana, storm, and merfolk tokens.

3727-4825.description:
Cast Emrakul for {15}.
Emrakul triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Tap Karakas to return Emrakul to your hand.
